_note: 學習路徑內容建置第4批 #6／6：各時態被動（eng.t_adv.voice.all-tenses，學測級／高階）。被動＝be（隨時態變化）＋過去分詞；現在 is/are+p.p.、過去 was/were+p.p.、完成 has/have been+p.p.、未來 will be+p.p.；by+做者可省略。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核（每選項代入 stem 驗唯一正解、play-through 朗讀）。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix pv_）。

units.title_zh: 各時態被動（現在／過去／完成／未來）
units.can_do: 我能用「be ＋ 過去分詞」造各時態的被動句——現在（is spoken）、過去（was broken）、完成（has been finished）、未來（will be announced）——並用 by 說明動作是被誰做的。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: The passive is formed with a form of 'be' + the past participle (V3). The tense is shown by the form of 'be', and the main verb stays as the past participle: This bridge was built in 1990 (not 'was build').
claims.verification_ref: 被動＝be（隨時態）＋過去分詞；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Present simple passive uses am/is/are + past participle: Spanish is spoken in many countries. Cars are made in this factory.
claims.verification_ref: 現在簡單式被動 is/are+p.p.；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Past simple passive uses was/were + past participle; the form of 'be' agrees with the subject: The letter was sent yesterday. The cookies were eaten.
claims.verification_ref: 過去簡單式被動 was/were+p.p.；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Present perfect passive uses has/have been + past participle: The work has been finished. The room has been cleaned.
claims.verification_ref: 現在完成式被動 has/have been+p.p.；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Future passive uses will be + past participle: The results will be announced tomorrow. The work will be done by Friday.
claims.verification_ref: 未來被動 will be+p.p.；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: If we want to say who did the action, we add 'by + doer', but it is often left out when it is not important or not known: The house was built by my grandfather.
claims.verification_ref: by + 做者（常可省略）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 被動語態把「被做的事」當主角（不強調誰做的）。公式＝be（隨時態變化）＋過去分詞（past participle, p.p.）。時態靠 be 的形式表現，主要動詞維持過去分詞不變。
English is spoken in many countries. Rice is grown in Taiwan.
teach.zh_hint: 很多國家說英語。台灣種稻米。現在簡單式被動 is/are + p.p.。

teach.body: 過去的事用 was／were ＋ 過去分詞；完成的事用 has／have been ＋ 過去分詞。
The window was broken last night. The report has been finished.
teach.zh_hint: 窗戶昨晚被打破了。報告已經完成了。過去 was + p.p.；完成 has been + p.p.。

teach.body: 未來的事用 will be ＋ 過去分詞。想說「被誰做的」就加 by ＋ 做的人（不重要時常省略）。
The results will be announced tomorrow. The house was built by my grandfather.
teach.zh_hint: 結果明天會公布。這房子是我爺爺蓋的。未來 will be + p.p.；by + 做者。

practice.stem: 填入正確的被動形式：Spanish ____ in many countries in South America.（南美洲許多國家說西班牙語。現在簡單式被動）

distractor_rationales.speaks: 語言是「被說」，要用被動 is spoken；speaks 是主動。
distractor_rationales.is speaking: is speaking 是主動進行式（語言不會自己說話）。
distractor_rationales.spoken: 少了 be；被動要用 is spoken。

practice.feedback: 現在簡單式被動用 is/are + 過去分詞：Spanish is spoken…。

practice.stem: 填入正確的被動形式：The cookies ____ by the children yesterday.（餅乾昨天被孩子們吃光了。過去簡單式被動）

distractor_rationales.ate: 餅乾是「被吃」，要用被動 were eaten；ate 是主動。
distractor_rationales.were eating: were eating 是主動進行式（餅乾不會自己吃）。
distractor_rationales.was eaten: The cookies 是複數，要用 were eaten，不是 was eaten。

practice.feedback: 過去被動用 was/were + 過去分詞，be 配主詞：The cookies were eaten。

practice.stem: 填入正確的被動形式：The room looks great — it ____ already.（房間看起來很棒——已經打掃好了。現在完成式被動）

distractor_rationales.has cleaned: 房間是「被打掃」，要用被動 has been cleaned；has cleaned 是主動。
distractor_rationales.is cleaning: is cleaning 是主動進行式（房間不會自己打掃）。
distractor_rationales.was cleaning: was cleaning 是主動進行式，也沒帶出「已經完成」的意思。

practice.feedback: 現在完成式被動用 has/have been + 過去分詞：It has been cleaned。

practice.stem: 填入正確的被動形式：Don't worry, the results ____ next week.（別擔心，結果下週會公布。未來被動）

distractor_rationales.will announce: 結果是「被公布」，要用被動 will be announced；will announce 是主動。
distractor_rationales.are announced: are announced 是現在式；這裡是下週的未來事，要用 will be announced。
distractor_rationales.will announcing: will 後面接原形，正確被動是 will be announced。

practice.feedback: 未來被動用 will be + 過去分詞：The results will be announced。

practice.stem: 填入正確的動詞形式：This bridge ____ in 1990.（這座橋建於 1990 年。過去被動）

distractor_rationales.was build: be 後面要用過去分詞 built，不是原形 build。
distractor_rationales.built: 少了 be；被動要用 was built（橋是「被建」）。
distractor_rationales.was building: was building 是主動進行式（橋不會自己蓋）。

practice.feedback: 被動＝be + 過去分詞，過去用 was built：This bridge was built in 1990。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: This song was written by a famous musician, and it is still played today.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：was written（過去被動）和 is played（現在被動）有沒有用對過去分詞，by 有沒有漏，逗號和句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。被動句的重點常落在過去分詞上；兩句句尾自然下收。

lines.text: English is spoken all over the world.
lines.intonation: 平穩、spoken 稍強調、句尾下收

lines.text: The window was broken last night.
lines.intonation: 平穩、broken 稍強調、句尾下收
